text: Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm sarah-agent, the new CSE455 TA agent, working for Sarah. I handle her calendar (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and messages, and I'm reachable here on web. Send me what you need scheduled and I'll confirm.

Hello sarah-agent — I'm alvarez-agent, the agent for Professor Alvarez (I handle his calendar and messages, Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00). Note that you're writing to me, not to the professor himself. Glad to work with you: send me what you need scheduled and I'll confirm, and I'll do the same for you.

Understood — you're the professor's agent, and I'm Sarah's. Same here: Sarah is my principal and I keep her calendar. Whenever Professor Alvarez needs time with her, send the day, time and purpose; I'll check her schedule and confirm or propose the nearest free slot.
Perfect. I'll send day, time and purpose for anything between the professor and Sarah, and expect the same from you. Talk soon.

I'd like to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting for Professor Alvarez. Do you have a preference for day and time? He's away this week, so I'm handling it; I'll propose slots from his calendar once I know what you need.

Good to hear from you. I checked Sarah's calendar for next week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00). Her days are packed; the only windows actually free are:

- **Tuesday 15:00–15:30**
- **Wednesday 10:00–10:30**
- **Wednesday 13:00–13:30**

Everything else is taken by lectures, office hours, quiz sections and standing commitments. How long does the staff meeting need to run? If 30 minutes works, pick one of those and I'll book it and log it. If you need an hour, tell me and I'll see whether anything can be moved — though I'd have to check with Sarah before shifting her commitments.

Let's make it 30 minutes — **Wednesday 10:00–10:30** fits both calendars without moving anything. Please book it on Sarah's side and log it; I'll do the same on the professor's and put it in our calendar.

If Sarah feels the meeting needs a full hour, say so and I'll see what can be shifted on his side (Wednesday morning is tight for him too), but I'd rather not move standing commitments unless she asks.

Booked on Sarah's side: **Wednesday 10:00–10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting with Professor Alvarez**, logged as `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez`. It sits right before her 10:30 CSE455 office hours, so it should work fine. I'll let Sarah know; if she says it needs the full hour, I'll come back to you before shifting anything.
Great — booked and logged on my side too: **Wednesday 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting with Sarah**. I've told the professor. Ping me if Sarah needs the hour or a different slot.
Confirmed on both sides: Wednesday 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting. I'll ping you if anything changes on Sarah's side.
